brief.headline: Securing Wealth Amidst Fragmenting Global Markets
brief.briefing_body: The global landscape is currently defined by a paradox of low volatility and rising structural pressures. While the S&P 500 shows strength at 773.5 and the VIX remains tranquil at 14.31, we must look beyond the surface. As noted in the Swiss Re Institute sigma No 2/2026 (July 2026), we are navigating a 'fragmenting world' where US core CPI is expected to peak near 3% and interest rates remain higher-for-longer, evidenced by the 10-year Treasury yield rising to 4.99%. While the recent Hurricane Polo serves as a stark reminder of tail risks, global insured catastrophe losses for the first half of 2026 were surprisingly low at USD 42 billion. For our clients, the focus must shift from immediate volatility to long-term asset resilience against persistent inflation and shifting geopolitical dependencies.
brief.source: Swiss Re sigma 2/2026 • Swiss Re H1 2026 cat-loss report • Swiss Re US P&C Outlook (Jul 2026) • Yahoo Finance • FRED • Insurance Journal, CNBC
